generation.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: original equipment recognition illustration for a Japanese agriculture learning app. Create ONE square image of a generic shoulder-carried MANUAL compression garden sprayer, clean colored 2D illustration with dark crisp outlines and restrained flat shading on an uncluttered warm white/ivory background. Center a complete upright compact cylindrical muted teal/gray pressure tank with rounded shoulders, a clearly visible raised manual top pump plunger and simple T-shaped handgrip, and ONE single broad shoulder carrying strap attached on opposite sides of the tank, forming one loose hanging loop. A flexible black hose connects the tank to a hand-held trigger grip and a slender long spray lance with small angled nozzle. The entire tank, full single strap, hose loop, trigger grip, full lance and nozzle must be fully visible with generous margins, clearly separated where possible, three-quarter front view. Show equipment only, resting as a coherent complete object, no person or hands, no spraying or liquid, no motor, no engine, no battery, no fuel tank, no backpack harness or paired shoulder straps, no wheels. No logos, no text, no labels, no annotations, no measurements, no arrows, no dosage, no cross section, no exploded view, no surrounding tools. Generic independent design, not an identifiable commercial model, not a copy of any photograph. Keep the manually operated top pump and single shoulder strap visually legible at phone-card size. Matte surfaces, no photorealistic texture.

titleJa: 肩掛け式手動噴霧器の外観例
altJa: 手動の上部ポンプ、一本の肩掛け帯、タンク、ホース、握り部と細長いノズル管を備えた噴霧器の独立したイラスト。
observationJa: 上部の手押しポンプと一本の肩掛け帯が見え、タンクからホースを通して握り部とノズル管へつながっています。エンジンやモーターは描いていません。手動で圧力を蓄えるという本文と外観を照合するための一般的な例です。
limitsJa: 特定製品の構造・寸法・容量・圧力設定・薬剤適合性・点検手順を示す図ではありません。霧や薬液、実際の散布作業は描いておらず、外観だけで加圧状態や安全性を確認したことにはなりません。二本の背負い帯を備える背負い式や動力式の代表図としては使いません。元資料の写真・配置は入力や複製に使っていません。

sourceItemBindings.noteJa: 1号PDF36では同じ外観写真に背負い式噴霧器のラベルがあります。2号PDF50は肩掛け式手動噴霧器と明示。本画像は2号の肩掛け手動の話題だけに用い、1号の背負い式区分を満たすと主張しません。
